collection.credit: NEW EVENTS — INNER LIFE, PART VII (121-140, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A villager has planned a surprise meal for a friend, and on the morning of it the friend says they cannot wait.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has spent days secretly planning a little surprise meal for (friend): (friend.his/her) favorite fish, a bowl of the sweet berries (friend.he/she) loves, and a few friends. Today, the morning of the surprise, (friend) says casually, "Can't wait for tonight!" (subject) freezes.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: "How did you find out?" (subject) groans. (friend) points at (subject)'s hut, where the berries are clearly visible in a bowl by the door. "I wasn't snooping, I promise. They were just... there." The meal is lovely anyway. Next time, (subject) decides, (subject.he/she) will hide the berries somewhere better.

a__fx.name: Answer A
a__fx.text: "Tonight? What's tonight?" says (subject), very badly. (friend) grins. That evening (friend) walks in, gasps, puts (friend.his/her) hands to (friend.his/her) face and says "A SURPRISE? For ME?" in the worst acting anyone has ever seen. Everybody laughs. The berries are excellent.
